section.content: 提供防止布线之间的交叉造成的串音并提高电路特性的半导体集成电路。通过在相对于差动放大器(1)的中心线的线对称位置，分别配置各个发射极跟随器电路(22、23)，没有如以往那样的布线之间的交叉区域，可以用一层金属布线(3)来连接电路块内的布线和接地线Vss。由此，可以消除因布线之间的交叉造成的串音问题。

This invention prevents a cross talk caused by intersection of interconnections, and offers a semiconductor integrated circuit with improved circuit characteristics. By disposing a pair of emitter follower circuits symmetrically with respect to a center line of a differential amplifier, an area where the interconnections cross with each other is eliminated and interconnections within a circuit block and a ground wiring can be made with a single metal layer. Herewith cross talk due to the intersection of the interconnections can be resolved.

Embodiment

One embodiment of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention is described with reference to the accompanying drawings.Below, be that example illustrates with widely used differential amplifier 1 in the bipolar linear integrated circuit.

In Fig. 1, the 1st, the circuit block (in the present embodiment, being differential amplifier) that bipolar transistor constitutes connects a pair of emitter follower circuit 22,23 on its a pair of differential output end.Here, each emitter follower circuit 22,23 disposes with the position that the center line with respect to this circuit block forms the line symmetry.

Thus, compare its paired property raising in the structure of asymmetrical position, the left and right sides from the centreline configuration of this differential amplifier with each emitter follower circuit 42,43 as the pair of differential lead-out terminal that will be connected to differential amplifier 11 of (shown in Figure 6) shown in the past.Therefore, applying the present invention to realize that the characteristic of semiconductor integrated circuit improves under differential amplifier will have paired property like that in its signal the situation of circuit structure.Having, except differential amplifier, for example also can be such circuit such as filter again, can be applicable to have the semiconductor integrated circuit that is connected to form the circuit structure of a pair of emitter follower circuit in a pair of output of its circuit.

Shown in the circuit structure diagram of Fig. 1, this differential amplifier 1 is shared and be connected to constant current transistor Q3 with the emitter of the 1st transistor Q1 and the 2nd transistor Q2, with each collector electrode of each transistor Q1, Q2 by resistance R 1, R2 are connected to power supply potential Vcc separately.

In addition, amplify by being applied to as the difference of the signal (Vin1, Vin2) between the base stage of each transistor Q1, Q2 of input terminal, and take out output signal (Vout1, Vout2) from the collector electrode of this transistor Q1, Q2, thereby each transistorized variable can be cancelled out each other, its output is not exerted an influence.

And each emitter follower circuit 22,23 that is connected to the output of differential amplifier 1 is configured in line symmetry respectively with respect to the center line of differential amplifier 1.Here, emitter follower circuit 22 by the collector electrode with transistor Q1 be connected to base stage transistor Q4, constant current is supplied with the constant current transistor Q6 of transistor Q4 and the emitter resistance R3 of this constant current transistor Q6 constitutes.And emitter follower circuit 23 equally by the collector electrode with transistor Q2 be connected to base stage transistor Q5, constant current is supplied with the constant current transistor Q7 of transistor Q5 and the emitter resistance R4 of this constant current transistor Q7 constitutes.

Like this, in the present invention, by at line symmetry with respect to the center line of differential amplifier 1, dispose emitter follower circuit 22,23 separately respectively, (shown in Figure 6) makes the zone that intersects between the wiring like that thereby do not have in the past, so can be with layer of metal connect up wiring and earth connection Vss in 3 circuit blocks that connect shown in the layout viewing of Fig. 2.Thus, can eliminate the crosstalk problem that the intersection between the wiring causes.And, can also make the equal in length of the wiring 6,7 between differential amplifier 1 and emitter follower circuit.Then, signal routing between circuit block is made of double layer of metal wiring 4, as the Vcc power line, can distribute to three-layer metal wiring 5, behind the arrangement method of constructing semiconductor integrated circuit, can realize the semiconductor integrated circuit that precision is higher with such layered structure.
